channel.title: CI/CD on DAWN's Blog
channel.description: Recent content in CI/CD on DAWN's Blog

item.title: SonarQube in Practice: Self-hosted Deployment, Token Setup, and Code Quality Scanning
item.description: A complete hands-on SonarQube self-hosting guide: JDK 8 and MySQL 5.6 setup, extracting SonarQube with plugins, running as a non-root user, web token configuration, and scanning code with the sonar-scanner client.

item.title: Jenkins in Practice: Self-hosted Deployment, Plugin Setup, and GitLab-Driven CI
item.description: A complete hands-on Jenkins self-hosting guide: RPM install of JDK and Jenkins, running as root, offline plugin install, and wiring GitLab SSH keyless access with webhook-triggered CI builds.

item.title: GitLab in Practice: Self-hosted Deployment, SSH Keyless Access, and Repository Management
item.description: A complete hands-on guide to self-hosting GitLab: RPM install, components, common commands, web UI setup, SSH keyless access, and multi-user collaboration.

item.title: How to Make Dockerfile Builds Faster: 10 Practical Optimization Tips
item.description: 10 proven tips — from cache strategy to multi-stage builds — to dramatically cut Docker build time.
